SHIPPING AND FULFILLMENT | FY2018-Q3 2026
G1-G6 | Strategic spine: who controls fulfillment?
[I] Keep the merchant interface; shift execution to partners.
|
+-- G2 Value engine
|   [S] Reliable fulfillment is intended to help merchants sell more.
|   [I] More merchant activity can support Shopify service revenue.
|   Merchant benefit -[D:claim]-> growth; no causal test supplied.
|
+-- Expand / Surge: software + partners, 2019-Q1 2021
|   [S] Original ambition: $1B over five years, mostly variable cost.
|   [R] 6 River Systems acquired in October 2019.
|   [S] Partners supplied capacity; Ottawa facility supported R&D.
|
+-- Build-ahead into Reckoning: more direct operation, 2021-2022
|   [S] Q3 2021: no change in direction; still finding product fit.
|   [S] Feb 2022: consolidate and operate more facilities.
|   [S] Plan: about $1B capex in 2023-24; $2B total through 2024.
|   [R] Deliverr purchase price: $1.972B, plus compensation awards.
|   [S] July 2022 close; logistics integration described as a bet.
|
+-- Reckoning: scale-back and sale, Q3 2022-Q2 2023
|   [S] 2022 company capex guide cut from $200M to $125M.
|   [R] Actual 2022 company purchases of property/equipment: $50M.
|   [I] Planned capex largely unrealized; acquisition cash was spent.
|   [S] Early 2023: integrate SFN; next call: sell to Flexport.
|   [R] Majority of logistics businesses sold June 6, 2023.
|   [R] $1.340B impairment after $528M non-cash consideration.
|   [R] Transaction brought a 13% Flexport equity interest.
|   [R] FY2022: Shopify-operated hubs plus third-party warehouses.
|   [I] Operating a facility need not mean owning its real estate.
|
+-- Focused compounding: partner model, Q3 2023-Q1 2025
|   [R] Nov 2023 commercial agreement: share of referred revenue.
|   [S] Merchant-facing SFN app retained, powered by Flexport.
|   [R] Flexport preferred for Shop Promise; $260M note purchased.
|   Partnership -[D:untestable]-> sustained merchant benefit.
|
+-- Capital outcome: equity and debt need separate readings
|   [R] Equity carrying value: $780M / $642M / $602M, 2023-25.
|   [R] Recognized equity-method losses: $58M / $138M / $40M.
|   [R] Agreement revenue recognized: nil in both 2024 and 2025.
|   [R] Note fair value: $326M at FY2025; interest also recognized.
|   [I] Total economic return and avoided losses remain unresolved.
|
+-- Shopify economics after exit
|   [S] Q1 2024 revenue growth: 23%; 29% excluding logistics.
|   [S] Q3 2023 margin excluding logistics: essentially flat.
|   [S] Post-sale capex averaged $4M/quarter by Q2 2024.
|   Exit -[D:assoc]-> better economics; other changes overlap.
|
+-- Reacceleration: retained tools and partners, Q2 2025 onward
|   [R] Shipping labels remain a revenue source in FY2025.
|   [S] 2025: more 3PLs, carriers and duty-paid label options.
|   [I] No new fulfillment outcome data in the Q3 2026 excerpt.
|
`-- G1 Interpretation
    [I] Failed integration bet and adaptive exit can coexist.
    [I] Merchant need persists; ownership was an experiment.
